missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend biotin solely for hair loss; clarify duration, other symptoms, current supplements and relevant laboratory testing.
safety_exclusions: Do not claim biotin improves hair in people without deficiency.
High-dose biotin can interfere with certain laboratory assays.
Do not delay evaluation of persistent or sudden hair loss.
professional_escalation_conditions: Sudden, patchy or scarring hair loss, systemic symptoms, pregnancy/postpartum context or suspected endocrine/iron disorders.
Upcoming cardiac, thyroid or other laboratory tests while taking high-dose biotin.
population_and_context: People concerned about hair loss without established biotin deficiency; cosmetic concern alone is not evidence of deficiency or benefit from biotin.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule; avoid high-dose cosmetic supplementation without indication and disclose biotin use before lab testing.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Biotin fact sheet notes limited evidence for hair/skin/nail claims in people without deficiency and laboratory assay interference. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
